acceptance_criteria: evidence add and cases record accept an absolute artifact path: the file is fingerprinted (SHA-256) in place within a 64 MiB bound and never copied into the project; missing, symlinked, directory and oversized external paths are refused by name. Project-relative canonical artifact behavior, freshness re-reads, digests and record shape are unchanged; a later change to the external file flips the observation's artifact freshness.
